summary: Tested the new Pepperstone AI trading bot (third bot) end to end. Backend: 32 of 33 tests passed on the first run (test_iter53 + new test_iter54, run with -n 0). The one failure was a real bug: chat messages sent from the Pepperstone panel were tagged as the Bybit panel. I fixed it in one line and re-ran the test, which then passed. The real LLM reply was in Spanish and correctly described the Pepperstone bot, Razor account and 7 USD/lote commission. Frontend: selector cards, /pepperstone branding, Razor/Standard switch, cTrader note, docs, chat chip, backup restore dialog and the /hotforex and /bybit regressions all pass. The only remaining problems are leftover texts.

minor.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: chat_routes.py mapped panel='pepper' to 'crypto' ("fx" if panel=='fx' else "crypto"). Messages were stored as panel crypto and context.snapshot reported 'panel_abierto_por_el_usuario: Bybit'. Now it accepts crypto/fx/pepper. Confirmed in Mongo chat_messages (panel='pepper').
